findings.issue: Under the bot allow-list, the NON_NORMALIZED_PATH entry in BOT_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS is now the only thing that blocks './x/../../storage/hand-store' (and './x/../../playtest/runner'), because the allow-list regex accepts any './' path. No probe covers this. Deleting the entry leaves every toolchain test passing. The existing dot probe 'src/bots/table-dot.ts' ('./../table/session') is still caught by the table/session allowImportNames pattern, so it doesn't pin this entry.
findings.evidence: Mutation: removing `{ regex: NON_NORMALIZED_PATH, message: BOT_BOUNDARY_MESSAGE }` from BOT_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS gives 40 passing tests in tests/toolchain/ (the only failure is sync-copies.test.ts, which fails because the scratch copy is not a git repo).

findings.issue: Two parts of ADVICE_TYPE_IMPORT_SYNTAX have no probe. (1) The `golden(\.|$)` exclusion in the first selector: type-position `import('./golden')` in advice. (2) The second selector: `import('../engine/hand').HandState` in advice. The code handles both correctly (in-process probes flag them), but a regression in either would go unnoticed. ADVICE_ALLOW_LIST_PROBES has only one type-position probe (probe-table-type), and the first selector's '../table' branch already catches that one.
findings.evidence: Mutation: dropping `|golden(\.|$)` from the advice TSImportType selector leaves 7/7 tests passing. Neutralising the advice engine/hand qualifier selector leaves every toolchain test passing (except the environmental sync-copies failure).
findings.fix: Add `'src/advice/probe-golden-type.ts': "export type G = import('./golden').GoldenSpot;\n"` and `'src/advice/probe-hand-type.ts': "export type H = import('../engine/hand').HandState;\n"` to ADVICE_ALLOW_LIST_PROBES.

findings.issue: adviceHiddenStateConfig now sets no-restricted-syntax, so it replaces botDeterminismConfig's options for src/advice and has to come after it. The duplication works only because it re-spreads BOT_DETERMINISM_RESTRICTED_SYNTAX. botSeatPolicyConfig's JSDoc states the same constraint, but this block's JSDoc does not. If someone reorders the blocks or adds an advice-only determinism entry to botDeterminismConfig, the advice determinism checks change without any warning.
findings.evidence: Line 213 has the 'Must come after botDeterminismConfig…' note for the bot block. Lines 273-279 for the advice block say nothing about rule replacement. Behaviour is correct today: Math.random, new Date(), bare crypto, globalThis.performance, dynamic import() and enum are all flagged in src/advice/zz.ts, and golden.ts (ignored by this block) keeps the determinism rules.
findings.fix: Add the same one-line note to the adviceHiddenStateConfig JSDoc: 'Must come after botDeterminismConfig: it replaces that block's no-restricted-syntax options for these files, so the determinism entries are repeated.'

findings.issue: The comment says advice type-position imports get 'engine types only from player-view and the Action, SeatNumber, Street names of engine/hand'. The selector also allows types from engine/cards, engine/hand-evaluator and engine/seeded-random, and it forbids STREET_BET_CAP, which the value pattern allows.
findings.evidence: Selector at line 262 allows `\.\./engine/(player-view|hand|cards|hand-evaluator|seeded-random)$`. `export type T = import('../engine/cards').Card` lints clean in src/advice.
findings.fix: Reword to: 'Same allow-list as ADVICE_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS for type-position import(); from engine/hand only Action, SeatNumber, Street.'

findings.issue: no-restricted-imports patterns are case-insensitive by default, but the TSImportType selectors are not. So `import('../advice/Golden').GoldenSpot` in bots, and `import('./Golden')` in advice, pass lint while the matching value imports fail. tsc rejects the casing mismatch (TS1149, forceConsistentCasingInFileNames), so npm run typecheck still catches it.
findings.evidence: In-process lint of `export type G = import('../advice/Golden').GoldenSpot;` in src/bots gives 0 errors. tsc --noEmit reports TS1149 for the same file.
findings.fix: Optional: add the `i` flag to the golden part of the two selectors (for example `/(^|\/)golden(\.|$)/i`), or leave it to typecheck.

findings.issue: Still open from round 1. Advice `import '../engine/hand';` passes, because allowImportNames skips imports with no specifiers. Bot `export {} from '../table/session';` passes for the same reason. No bindings are imported, so neither gives any data access.
findings.fix: Optional: now that adviceHiddenStateConfig has its own no-restricted-syntax list, add `{ selector: 'ImportDeclaration[specifiers.length=0][source.value=/(^|\\/)engine\\/hand$/]', message: ADVICE_BOUNDARY_MESSAGE }`.

findings.issue: SESSION_TYPE_NAMES is a constant, but the TSImportType selector hard-codes 'LineUpName|SessionConfig|SessionSeat'. If someone adds a name to one and not the other, value-style type imports and type-position import() go out of sync.
findings.evidence: Line 148 defines SESSION_TYPE_NAMES. Line 207 repeats the names in a regex.
findings.fix: Build the regex from the constant: `qualifier.name=/^(${SESSION_TYPE_NAMES.join('|')})$/`.

summary: All round-1 findings are resolved. Both MAJORs are fixed: bots importing '../advice/golden.js' or '.ts' now fail, and advice files importing './golden' in any form now fail, with probes for both. The round-1 MINOR on golden type-position imports is fixed. The round-1 MINOR on the advice non-normalized path is now tested: removing that entry fails a test. Q-2 / AC#3 allow-lists: 150 in-process probes all behave as intended. In src/bots, TableState and BotTurn fail in every form (import type, inline type, type-only and value default/namespace, export type, export {type}, export * and export type * with or without 'as', side-effect, empty-specifier import, import()/typeof import(), qualified names, .js/.ts, '/./', '//', 'x/..', './..', '.././', '../../src', absolute paths, import = require). storage/hand-store, playtest/runner, table/hint and stats fail in every form, including subfolder files. advice/golden fails with extensions and path variants, and a re-export through advice also fails. The allowed LineUpName/SessionConfig/SessionSeat type imports and re-exports, advice, player-view and Action/SeatNumber/Street imports still pass. npm run lint exits 0 on the repo, and every current import in src/bots and src/advice lints clean. The advice no-restricted-syntax list re-spreads the same BOT_DETERMINISM_RESTRICTED_SYNTAX constant that botDeterminismConfig uses, so the entries match exactly, and determinism probes still fire in src/advice. Against the f29cfae config, 3 of the 7 tests fail. Mutation testing removed 15 individual new entries: 12 fail a test. The three that don't are covered by the MINOR test-gap findings (the bot non-normalized entry, which is the only guard against './x/../../storage/hand-store', plus the advice type-position golden and engine/hand selectors). The locked TASK-6.21 test passes and git diff vs main is empty for src. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
